issues.description: Failed ingests still commit valid rows before returning nonzero when malformed rows exceed the threshold.
Failure reports only match OOM and miss OUT_OF_MEMORY states, so real out-of-memory jobs can be omitted.
Timestamp filtering and newest-record selection compare ISO strings lexicographically instead of normalizing chronological datetimes.
AllocTRES parsing accepts negative GPU counts, which can produce negative GPU-hour totals.
Custom argparse error handling exits with a string SystemExit/status 1 instead of the standard usage-error status 2.
Step-job filtering only checks for dots, so other non-top-level Slurm job-id forms can be ingested.
Header validation requires exact field order and rejects otherwise usable sacct exports with reordered or extra columns.
Malformed-threshold test asserts only the exit code and does not catch the database mutation caused by a failed ingest.
Project has tests but no configured formatter, linter, type checker, or coverage gate for ongoing maintenance.
